title: Transport Credit on Therapy Visit Copays
content:
## Transport credit on therapy visit copays

**Clause.** Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, the re-rated copay of a rehabilitation therapy course visit is lowered by a transport credit that follows how the child reaches therapy:

- Where the member's transportation level of service is RideLink Wheelchair Van or RideLink Stretcher Van and at least 3 completed trips (the transported course minimum) reached the therapy provider in the therapy window, the credit is the transported course credit of 1.00 USD.
- Where that level of service holds with fewer such trips, the credit is the occasional transport credit of 0.50 USD.
- Otherwise there is no transport credit.

The transport credit is subtracted from the re-rated copay of each course visit that is neither an intake visit nor an extension visit, and that copay, after the credits subtracted from it, is never below zero.

## Records read

- The level of service is the one on the member's Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit.
- A trip counts when the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip record shows it completed, with the therapy authorization's servicing provider as its destination and an appointment date in the therapy window, the 12 months counted back from the review date.

## Basis questions

**Which trips count toward the 3?** Completed trips whose destination is the servicing provider of the course, with appointment dates in the therapy window. Trips to other providers, and trips not completed, do not count.

**What if the member rides a RideLink Wheelchair Van but no trip reached the therapy provider?** The level of service holds with fewer than 3 such trips, so the credit is 0.50 USD.

**What if the level of service is RideLink Ambulatory Sedan with ten trips to the therapy provider?** The level of service is neither RideLink Wheelchair Van nor RideLink Stretcher Van, so there is no transport credit.

## Threshold cases (hypothetical)

| Level of service | Completed trips to the therapy provider in the window | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 3 | 1.00 USD |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 2 | 0.50 USD |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 7 | 1.00 USD |
| RideLink Transit Pass | 7 | none |

A hypothetical course visit with a re-rated copay of 0.75 USD and a transport credit of 1.00 USD re-rates at 0.00 USD, not below zero.
